# H-LIMB-1 CONFIRMED.  SIX payloads, SIX distinct byte lengths spanning 28 B (1 063 - 1 091), SIX
# distinct sha256_12, ONE fold digest.  p380's span was 17 B; this one is wider, and it is a
# SECOND pass reaching the same constant from a disjoint sample.
# 🟢 THE LOAD-BEARING ROW IS THE ONE THAT DID NOT FOLD.  `aaryansamanta/nextgen-ai` has
# `MIT License (Code)` on its title line and would satisfy any string matcher, any licence API and
# any manifest field.  Its operative clause has been EDITED — the canonical "of this software and
# associated documentation files" is replaced by "of the source code files in this repository" —
# and its payload carries an explicit carve-out: brand assets, team photos, videos, logos and the
# top-level PDFs are "not covered by the MIT license above".  🔴 A classifier that reads the root
# LICENSE and stops is RIGHT ABOUT THE CODE AND WRONG ABOUT THE REPOSITORY, and that is this
# base's whole ladder.  p378's fold catches it for free, because the fold is of the TEXT.
# 🟢 SEPARATELY, A FREE OUT-OF-SAMPLE CONTROL ON p310's CC0 PIN.  `kuzand/Computer-Vision-Video-
